summary: The change implements Date.prototype.toUTCString by calling existing helpers in crate::support::date (this_time_value, week_day, month_from_time, date_from_time, year_from_time, time_string). The control flow matches the spec: RequireInternalSlot via this_time_value with `?`, the NaN check returns "Invalid Date", and weekday/month come from fixed name tables indexed by WeekDay and MonthFromTime. Day and year are zero-padded to 2 and 4 digits, the year sign is "-" when YearFromTime is negative, and the final format string has the same piece order as step 11. There are no test-shaped branches, no swallowed errors, and no made-up values. The only deviation is cosmetic: steps 1-3 share one comment and the verbatim spec step text was replaced by paraphrase, which the ticket's comment rule arguably asks for. I could not inspect the support::date helpers, so I am assuming they exist and behave per spec, as the passing build and gate report suggest.
